title: Tool card
description: The front matter of catalog/tools/<id>.md. The id is the file name. A tool card is written for any project: one tied to a language describes the role (the project's test command), and its vendors list the products that can play it, from several stacks.

sensors.description: The sensors this tool builds. The sensor's card never lists its tools: that is computed from here.

layer.description: Where the tool is: project (run from the project's checkout: its commands and libraries, and the command-line tools beside them), system (outside it: a service, an environment or a store the project reaches), agent (part of the coding agent itself).

vendors.description: The products that can play this tool's role, from several stacks. The list is not closed, and the one a project uses is still found in the project. Each names where to read about it and, in a short note, the stack it serves or how it plays the role.

note.description: One line of Markdown, shown after the name.
